# tfcensus move plan

plan reads each involved unit's state from S3, applies the block in memory and plans every
unit against its new state through a local backend override (\_tfcensus\_override.tf), with its
own credentials. A surgery block passes when every resource change is no-op or read; output
changes don't count. Blocks run in order, so a later block sees an earlier one's result.

A native block only lists the files apply would write.

Exit codes: 3 when a block is rejected (MV-VERIFY, MV-PLAN, MV-ACCOUNT or MV-VERSIONING), 4 when
the backend credentials fail, and 2 for a file or flag error.

## Usage

```sh
tfcensus move plan <migration-file> [flags]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `migration-file` | yes | no |

## Flags

| Flag | Description | Type | Default | Values | Config key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--block` | run only these blocks (default: all, in file order) | list, repeatable |  |  |  |  |
| `--repo` | repository root that the file's unit paths are relative to | string | `.` |  |  |  |
| `--var` | set var.NAME in the migration file, as NAME=VALUE | string, repeatable |  |  |  |  |

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Output formats

`--format` accepts `tty`, `plain`, `json`, `sarif`. Without it, the format is `tty` when stdout is a terminal and `plain` otherwise. Formats are described on the [global flags](/cli/global-flags) page.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The command finished. With --fail-on, nothing matched. |
| 1 | The command failed: a read, a write, a child process or a check failed. |
| 2 | Wrong usage: an unknown command or flag, a bad value or argument, an invalid config file, or a prompt with no terminal. |
| 3 | A --fail-on gate matched. The report is still written. |
| 4 | Credentials were missing or rejected for every source the command needed. |
| 130 | Interrupted by Ctrl-C (SIGINT) or a cancelled context. |

All codes are listed on the [exit codes](/reference/exit-codes) page.

## Examples

```sh
tfcensus move plan migrations/split_network.hcl
tfcensus move plan migrations/split_network.hcl --block split_network --var env=prod
```
